summary: Re-verified Back-button real-mouse click fix on HomeNextNav and mobile burger regression. Both work. Back button centroid now resolves to <SPAN> (icon inside button), NOT input.hn-nav__toggle. Real mouse click on Back on /luxury-next navigates back to previous history entry ('/'). Mobile burger still toggles open/close even though checkbox is display:none, via label[for]+ :checked sibling selector.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix in /app/frontend/src/components/homenext/homeNext.css (.hn-nav__toggle { display:none }) is verified. Desktop 1920px: on /luxury-next after SPA nav from '/', document.elementFromPoint at Back centroid returns SPAN (inside BUTTON), real mouse click navigates to '/'. Mobile 390px: buy link hidden by default; burger click sets checkbox.checked=true and shows nav-buy; second click closes. No horizontal overflow (scrollW 390 == clientW 390). Back and Home icons remain visible in mobile top bar.
rca of the issue: N/A - fix confirmed. Previously input.hn-nav__toggle absolutely-positioned overlay (opacity:0) intercepted pointer events on desktop. Setting display:none removes it from the hit-testing tree entirely; label click still toggles :checked, so mobile menu CSS `.hn-nav__toggle:checked ~ .hn-nav__links { display:flex }` continues to function.
